title: One operation-level damage-control case
description: A case is an (input, context) pair and the verdict it must produce. `class` groups cases into one test per failure class; `source` says where the case came from, so a lost expectation can be traced.

tool.description: Bash -> check_command; Read -> check_read_path; Edit/Write -> check_path (and is_protected_control_plane for `control_plane`).

ruleset.description: rules = bundled rule YAMLs; full = rules + tooldefs (what a fresh install runs). Default full.

home.description: $HOME while the case runs. Default /golden/home (deliberately not under /tmp).

decision.description: Bash: decision must be (one of) these.

decision_not.description: Bash: decision must not be (any of) these.

protected.description: Bash: result is / is not flagged protected control plane.

unverifiable.description: Bash: result is / is not flagged unverifiable (verb-concealing).

blocked.description: Read/Edit/Write: the path is / is not blocked.

reason_contains.description: Read/Edit/Write: block reason contains this text.

control_plane.description: Edit/Write: the path is / is not protected control plane.

class.description: Failure class; the runner emits one test per class.

source.description: file::symbol the case was converted from.
